title: Concat — Concatenation
description: Learn to append two sequences together using the Concat operator.

data.text: The `Concat` method appends two sequences of the same type and returns a new sequence (collection).

data.title: Concat Example
Concat vs Union
data.text: Concat appends all elements including duplicates. Use Union if you want to remove duplicates.

data.title: Not Supported in Query Syntax
data.text: The Concat operator is not supported in query syntax in C# or VB.NET.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Both sequences must be of the same type
data.takeaway: Continue to the next module to learn about aggregation operators.
